title: Functorial Epigenetic Realignment (FER): Reversing Topological Drift via Information-Geometric Optimal Transport and Mechanotransductive Acoustic Holography
description: A falsifiable theoretical and computational framework for testing whether age-associated cellular-state transitions admit a useful geometric representation and mechanically controllable directions. FER combines topological data analysis, information geometry, Wasserstein optimal transport, categorical control, mechanobiology, active-matter defect descriptors, and acoustic holography as a candidate field-synthesis layer.
